Strong Demand for Tiger’s Products and Services in Southeast Asia
Repeat order from partners expands Tiger's merchant footprint and validates its
distribution model in Vietnam
Vancouver, BC and San Juan, Puerto Rico, September 29, 2026 – TheNewswire - Tiger Financial Services Inc.,

(“Tiger” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that one of its commercial partners in Vietnam has ordered an additional 1,000 point of sale devices (“POS”) for deployment across its merchant network in Vietnam.

This additional order expands Tiger’s payment technology footprint in Vietnam and reflects the continued growth of its relationship with its commercial partners. Through established financial institution partnerships, Tiger is increasing the deployment of its payment infrastructure across a growing base of merchants and businesses. As Vietnam continues its transition toward digital and cashless payments,1 Tiger’s objective is to expand the number of installed base positions to participate in the long-term growth of the country’s payments ecosystem.

Ben Aissa, CEO of Tiger Financial, stated: “A repeat order is the clearest validation a technology company can receive. Our commercial partner has seen Tiger’s payment technology perform in the field, and they are now putting it in front of more of their merchants. This is exactly how our model is designed to work: to scale through licensed financial institutions that already own the merchant relationship, which allows us to grow quickly and efficiently while strengthening our position in one of Southeast Asia’s fastest growing digital payments markets. Vietnam’s shift to cashless payments is reaching merchants across multiple categories2 and we intend to pursue further deployments across thousands of merchant locations as demand continues to build.”

“The market dynamics we are seeing in Vietnam share similarities with those we experienced in Qatar, where our team built QPAY International into a leading fintech company before its acquisition by Qatar Islamic Bank. We are drawing on that experience as we develop our strategy for Vietnam, while leveraging an enhanced technology platform and pursuing a broader addressable market.3”

In addition, Tiger is pleased to announce that it has granted an aggregate of 200,000 stock options (“Options”) to certain advisors of the Company. The Options have an exercise price of $0.65 per share and an expiry date of five years from the date of grant. One-third of the 150,000 of the Options will vest on the first, second and third anniversaries of the date of grant, respectively, while one-half of the 50,000 of the Options will respectively vest on the first and second anniversaries of the date of grant, respectively.
About Tiger Financial Services Inc.

Tiger is an international fintech focused on high-growth emerging markets. Headquartered in Puerto Rico, the company develops and launches AI-powered banking infrastructure for small businesses across Southeast Asia. Led by founder and CEO Ben Aissa, a fintech entrepreneur with over 20 years of international experience scaling payments and banking ventures, Tiger combines AI-driven payments, digital banking, and embedded finance to serve one of the world's largest underserved business segments. Through its Vietnam subsidiary, Vietpay Technology Company Corporation, Tiger has an operating foothold in Southeast Asia and plans to expand across Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Cambodia, and Myanmar, a regional opportunity of more than 60 million small businesses. Tiger's model combines proprietary technology with deep market expansion expertise and partnerships with licensed commercial banks, enabling the company to deliver tailored local fintech services in full compliance with regulators while executing a multi-country high-growth strategy.
